strI, (puMso BarttuH sakASAt calati puruzAntaraM gacCatIti । cala + ac । gOrAditvAt NIz .) asatI । ityamaraH । 2 । 6 । 10 ॥ asyA amaroktaparyyAyaH kulawASabde liKitaH । tadatiriktaparyyAyo yaTA, DfzwA 1 duzwA 2 DarzitA 3 । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ laNkA 4 niSAcarI 5 trapAraRqA 6 । iti jawADaraH ॥ tasyAScaritradozAdi yaTA, -- “aho ! ko veda Buvane durjYeyaM puMScalImanaH । puMScalyAM yo hi viSvasto viDinA sa viqambitaH । bahizkftaSca yaSasA DarmmeRa svakulena ca ॥ vAYCitaM nUtanaM prApya vinaSyati purAtanam । sadA svakarmmasADyA sA ko vA tasyAH priyo'priyaH ॥ dEve karmmaRi pEtre ca puttre branDO ca Barttari । dAruRaM puMScalIcittaM sadA SfNgArakarmmaRi ॥ prARADikaM ratijYaM sAmftadfzwyA hi puMScalI । ratnapradaM ratyavijYaM vizadfzwyA hi paSyati ॥ sarvvezAM sTalamastyeva puMScalInAM na kutracit । dAruRA puMScalIjAtinaMrajAtiBya eva ca ॥ nizkftiH karmmaBogAnte sarvvezAmasti niScitam । na puMScalInAM viprendra ! yAvaccandradivAkarO ॥ anyAsAM kAminInAYca kIwaM hantuYca yA dayA । sA nAsti puMScalInAntu kAntaM hantuM purAtanam ॥ ratijYaM nUtanaM prApya vizatulyaM purAtanam । kAntaM dfzwvA hinastyeva sopAyenAvalIlayA ॥ * ॥ pfTivyAM yAni pApAni puMScalIzveva BArate । tizWanti tAByo na parAH pApizWAH santikecana ॥ puMScalIparipakvAnnaM sarvvapAtakamiSritam । dEve karmmaRi pEtre ca deyaM na ca taTA jalam ॥ annaM vizWA payo mUtraM puMScalInAYca niScitam । dattvA pitfByo deveByo BuktvA ca narakaM vrajet ॥ SatavarzaM kAlasUtre pacatyeva sudAruRe । GorAnDakAre kfmayastaM daSanti divAniSam ॥ puMScalyannaYca yo BuNkte dEvAdyadi narADamaH । saptajanmakftaM puRyaM tasya naSyati niScitam ॥ AyuHSrIyaSasAM hAniriha loke paratra ca । tasmAdyatnAdrakzaRIyaM pAkapAtraM kalatrakam ॥ puMScalIdarSane puRyaM yAtrAsidDirBavedDruvam । sparSane ca mahApApaM tIrTasnAnAdviSuDyati ॥ snAnaM dAnaM vrataYcEva japaSca devapUjanam । nizPalaM puMScalInAYca BArate jIvanaM vfTA ॥” upasTitasakAmapuMScalItyAge dozo yaTA, -- “rahasyupasTitAM kAmAt puMScalIYcejjitendriyaH । parityajedDarmmaBayAdaDarmmAnnarakaM vrajet ॥” sarvvadEva tasyAstapasvityAjyatvaM garhitatvaYca yaTA, “upasTitA ca yA yozidatyAjyA rAgiRAmapi । SrutO Srutamiti tyAjyA sarvvadEva tapasvinAm ॥ aho sarvvEH parityAjyA puMScalI ca viSezataH । DanAyuHprARayaSasAM nASinI duHKadAyinI ॥ svakAryyatatparA SaSvat parakAryyaviGAtinI । nizWarA naraGAtiByaH sarvvApadbIjarUpiRI ॥ vidyuddIptirjale reKA loBAnmEtrI yaTA Bavet । paradrohAdyaTA sampat kulawAprematatparam ॥ sarvveByo hiMsrajantuByo vipadbIjA sadEva sA । yo viSvasettAM saMmUQo vipattasya pade pade ॥” iti brahmavEvartte SrIkfzRajanmaKaRqe । 23 । 24 । 32 aDyAyAH ॥

yAvaccandradivAkarO । anyAsAM kAminInAYca kIwaM hantuYca tA dayA । sA BAsti puMScalInAntu kAntaM hantuM purAtanam । ratijYaM BUtanaM prApya vizatulyaM purAtanam । kAntaM dfzwvA hinastyeva sopAyenAvalIlayA । pfTivyAM yAni pApAni puMScalIzveva BArate । tizWanti tAByo na parAH pApizWAH santi kecana । puMScasIparipakAnnaM sarba pAtakamiSritam । dEve karmaRi pEtre ca deyaM na ca taTA jalam । annaM vizWA payo mUtraM puMScalInAYca niScitam । dattvA pitfByo deveByo BuktvA ca narakaM vrajet । SanavarzaM kAlasUtre pacatyeva sudAruRe । GorAnDakAre kfmayastadadanti divAniSam । puMScalyannaYca yo BuNkte dEvAdyadi narAGamaH । saptajanmakftaM puRya tasya naSyati niScitam । AyuHSrIyaSasAM hAniriha loke paratra ca । tasmAdyatrAdrakzaRoyaM pAkapAtraM kalatrakam । puMScalIdarSane puRyaM yAtrAsidDirBavedDruvam । sparSacce ca mahApApaM nIrTasyAnAdviSudDyati । snAnaM dAnaM vrataYcEva japaSca devapUjanam । nizPalaM puMsalInAYca mArate jIvanaM taTA” । “aho sarvE parityAjyA puMScalI ca viSazataH । DanAyuHprARayaSasAM nASinI duHKadAyinI । svakAryyatatparA SaSvat parakAryyaviGAtinI । nizWurA naraGAtiByaH sarvApadvIjarUpiRI । vidyuddIptirjale reKA loBAnmEtrI yaTA Bavet । paradrohAdyaTA sampat kulawA prema tatparam । sarveByo hisrajantuByo vipadbIjA sadEva sA । yoviSvasettAM saMmUQo vipattasya pade pade” ।

[पाति पा-पालने डुम्सुन् Uṇ. 4. 147] (Nom. पुमान्, पुमांसौ, पुमांसः; Instr. du. पुंभ्यां; Voc. sing. पुमन्) 1 A male, male being; पुंसि विश्वसिति कुत्र कुमारी N. 5. 110. --2 A man, human being; यस्यार्थाः स पुमाँल्लोके H. 1. --3 Man, mankind, people; वंद्यैः पुंसां रघुपतिपदैः Me. 12. --4 A servant, an attendant. --5 A word inthe masculine gender. --6 The masculine gender; पुंसि वा हरिचंदनं Ak. --7 The soul. --Comp. --अनुज a. ( पुंसानुज) having an elder brother. --अनुजा (पुमनुजा) a girl born after the male child; i. e. a girl having an elder brother. --अपत्यं (पुमपत्यं) a male child. --अर्थः (पुमर्थः) {1} the aim of man. {2} any one of the four ends of human existence; i. e. धर्मं, अर्थं, काम and मोक्ष; see पुरुषार्थ. --आख्या (पुमाख्या) a designation of a male being. --आचारः (पुमाचारः) a usage of men. --कांटः f. a man's hip. --कामा a woman wishing for a husband. --कोकिलः a male cuckoo; Ku. 3. 32. --खेटः (पुंखेटः) a male plant. --गवः (पुंगवः) {1} a bull, an ox. {2} (at the end of comp.) chief, best, most excellent, distinguished or pre-eminent of any class; वाल्मीकिर्मुनिपुंगवः Rām.; so गजपुंगवः Bh. 2. 31; नरपुंगवः &c. ˚केतुः an epithet of Śiva; Ku. 7. 77. --चलः (पुंश्चलः) an adulterer. --चली (पुंश्चली) a harlot, an unchaste woman; Y. 1. 162 --चलीयः (पुंश्चलीयः) the son of a harlot. --चलू f. (पुंश्चलू) Ved. a harlot. --चिह्नं (पुंश्चिह्न) the characteristic of a male, the membrum virile. --जन्मन् (पुंजन्मन्) n. the birth of a male child. ˚करः, ˚दः, ˚योगः a constellation under which male children are born. --दासः ( पुंदासः) a male slave. --ध्वजः (पुं वजः) {1} the male of any species of animal. {2} a mouse. --नक्षत्रं (पुंनक्षत्रं) a male asterism. {2} an asterism under which male children are born. --नागः (पुंनागः) {1} ‘an elephant among men’, a distinguished man. {2} a white elephant. {3} a white lotus. {4} nutmeg. {5} N. of a tree called नागकेशर; R. 4. 57. --नाटः, --डः ( पुंनाटः, --डः) N. of a tree. --नामधेयः (पुंनामधेयः) a male. --नामन् ( पुंनामन्) a. holding a masculine name. (--m.) {1} the tree called पुंनाग. {2} N. of a hell. --पुत्रः a male child. --प्रजननं the male organ of generation. --भूमन् (पुंभूमन्) m. a word of the masculine gender used only in the plural number; दाराः पुंभूम्नि चाक्षताः Ak. --योगः (पुंयोगः) {1} cohabitation with men. {2} reference to a male or husband; पुंयोगे क्षत्रियी. --रत्नं (पुंरत्नं) an excellent man. --राशिः (पुंराशिः) a male sign of the zodiac. --रूपं (पुंरूपं) the form of a man. --लिंग a. (पुंलिंग) of the masculine gender, masculine. --(गं) {1} masculine gender. {2} virility, manhood. {3} the male organ. --वत्सः ( पुंवत्सः) a bull-calf. --वृषः (पुंवृषः) the musk-rat. --वेष a. (पुंवेष) dressed like a male, clad in male, attire. --सवन (पुंसवन) a. causing the birth of a male child. --(नं) the first of the purificatory Saṃskāras: it is a ceremony performed on a woman's perceiving the first signs of a living conception, with a view to the birth of a son; R. 3. 10. {2} fœtus {3} milk
